notes.title: Version 0.3.5.0 - Visual improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS
The graveyard screen has been updated with all cards, now when they go to the graveyard, they occupy their place in an orderly manner, which makes it easier to see which ones have been played and which are missing.

The Juda button disappears when it is not needed.

When closing the blessings menu in the game, it closes directly even if you have selected a blessing.


BUG FIXES
The issue of missions not appearing has been fixed. This was due to completed missions being destroyed; now they are put back into the deck and shuffled.

The description of the cards for sale that was repeated has been corrected.

The problem of hand cards disappearing in circle 4 under very specific circumstances has been resolved.

notes.title: Visual improvement of the graveyard
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS IN THE GRAVEYARD


An option has been added to view the cards you have in the graveyard, so you can know the cards you've used and get an idea of the ones you have left in the deck
Visual effect on the "Statistics" tab when you have expiations to redeem

BUG FIXES


A bug has been fixed where sometimes the turn counter die for expiations would get stuck on 1

notes.title: Difficulty update
notes.content:
NEW CONTENT


 When you are unable to place a card on the board, you will be able to remove a card from your hand using one of the three available daggers. They can be used in the same circle or in different ones and will be unique for each run. Upon starting a new game, they will be available again.


BUG FIXES


 The error that caused some missions to disappear and leave the slot empty has been fixed.
 The error that ended the game when you ran out of cards even though you have the last chant to complete has been corrected.


VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS


 A visual effect has been added to the die to confirm when penance occurs:
 1 to 3 (penance occurs) dark blink
 4 to S (penance does not occur) glow

notes.title: Language update
notes.content:
New languages:

 Catalan
 Polish
 French
 Portuguese (Portugal)

New features:

 The badges in the menu light up according to the level reached
 At the end of a game, the statistics menu opens directly
Fixed errors:

 Smaller text for the chants so they don't get cut off
 Fixed the issue with the blessings to change cards from the deck when there were no cards left in the deck
 The first circle has no curses
 The curse that discards used cards now only discards 1 at random
